last_summary: Evidence supports v4 as quinoa cooking/draining, v3 as tomato dicing into a herb/onion base, and v5 as adding quinoa to that bowl and mixing it. v2 shows a finished quinoa salad and later container pours/spice, placing it after v5. v1 shows lemon squeezing and olive-oil presentation near the salad bowl, and its olive-oil handoff aligns with v2's dark-bottle pour, so the best-supported chronology is v4 -> v3 -> v5 -> v1 -> v2.
